links.comparator_used: Baseline LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, Vicuna-13B, ChatGLM-6B) answering without Med-RISE retrieval augmentation. Med-RISE is a bundled package of query rewriting, local and real-time retrieval, summarization and a fact and safety filter, so the effect is not isolated to retrieval.
links.outcome: Answer accuracy and hallucination rate on MedQA, PubMedQA, MedMCQA and EYE500
links.effect: Accuracy improved by 9.8% to 16.3% (mean 13%, SD 2.3%): GPT-3.5 16.3%, GPT-4 12.9%, Vicuna-13B 13%, ChatGLM-6B 9.8%. Hallucinations fell by 11.8% to 18% (mean 15.1%, SD 2.8%): factuality hallucinations down 13.5%, faithfulness hallucinations down 5.8%.
links.quote: The integration of Med-RISE with each LLM led to a substantial increase in accuracy, with improvements ranging from 9.8% to 16.3% (mean 13%, SD 2.3%) across the 4 datasets.

design_hint: retrieval grounding with fact and safety output filter
